T: Meet me at the top of the Empire State.
D: A widower's son calls a radio show and a woman across the country falls for his dad.
P: Serve dessert when they finally meet on the observation deck.
S: Flake hot-smoked salmon into cream cheese and crème fraîche with lemon, dill, capers and horseradish. Bagel chips.

Sweet crab bound with a little mayo, mustard and crumb, seasoned with paprika and celery salt, fried golden with tartare. Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, half a tsp each of celery salt and paprika, chopped parsley and 60g panko. Shape 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 3 minutes a side. Mix 120g mayonnaise with chopped cornichons, capers, dill and lemon for tartare.
listening to the late night call-in show
Pop kernels in coconut oil, toss with brown butter (butter cooked until nutty) and flaky salt.
M: the Seattle waterfront near Sam's houseboat

Flathead in crisp lager batter with double-cooked chips, lemon, and a quick dill tartare on the side. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, simmer 6 minutes, drain and dry. Fry at 160C for 5 minutes, then rest. Whisk 150g plain flour, 50g cornflour, 1 tsp baking powder and 300ml cold lager. Dip 600g flathead fillets in flour, then batter, and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry chips again at 190C until golden. Serve with lemon and tartare.
Roast salmon fillet with herb crust, steamed greens and lemon butter, nothing that'll set Walter off sneezing.
W: the Empire State date on Valentine's Day
Brown butter sugar cookie dough rolled 5mm, cut into hearts, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, iced in red and white royal icing.
K: Seattle, the coffee city, where Sam and Jonah live on the water

Strong coffee and dark chocolate over ice with cold milk, under whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 400ml strong coffee and stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp sugar until melted. Cool for 15 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 100ml of the mocha and 150ml cold milk to each. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and dust with cocoa.

steps.text: Flake the salmon into the cream cheese and crème fraîche.

Bake at 180C into crisp chips.
Serve the chips with the dip.
Cook the butter until nutty and golden.
Heat the coconut oil with 3 kernels in a lidded pot.
Add the rest of the kernels once they pop, cover and shake until popping slows.
Toss with the brown butter and flaky salt.
Mix the panko with parsley, lemon zest and oil.
Press onto the salmon and roast at 200C.
Steam the beans.
Melt the butter with the lemon juice and spoon over everything.

s.how: Flake 200g hot-smoked salmon into 150g cream cheese and 100ml crème fraîche. Add lemon juice, chopped dill, 1 tbsp capers and 1 tsp horseradish. Slice 2 bagels thin, brush with oil and bake at 180C for 10 minutes into chips.

s.note: listening to the late night call-in show
s.how: Cook 60g butter until it smells nutty and goes golden. Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until popping slows. Toss with the brown butter and flaky salt.

m.how: Mix 50g panko with chopped parsley, lemon zest and oil. Press onto 4 salmon fillets and roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Steam 300g green beans. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and spoon over everything.

w.note: the Empire State date on Valentine's Day
w.how: Brown 125g butter and cool. Beat with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll to 5mm, cut into hearts and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, half tinted red.

d.note: Seattle, the coffee city, where Sam and Jonah live on the water
d.how: Brew 400ml strong coffee and stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp sugar until melted. Cool for 15 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 100ml of the mocha and 150ml cold milk to each. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and dust with cocoa.
